text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chaaan! I looked through that 'Babe 
Notebook' you gave me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Full of hip and trendy maxims! Big sis 
here is deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I tried studying the 'bleeding-edge' slang 
that Maruzen-san talks about... Did I get 
anything wrong?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"If you take it too easy, you'll run out 
of time." "When you're looking good, do 
the rumba with all your might"—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a million for putting so much 
thought into it! Both the "Mabu Notebook" 
and Chiyo-chan are totally, completely 
super-mabu♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the wonderful birthday present, 
Chiyo-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine... I'm so glad 
you liked it!
